papers.title: Multi-agent LLM teams improve differential recall on curated cases but underperform on emergency working-label matching: a two-cohort, two-family evaluation
papers.translated_title: 多智能体大语言模型团队在精选病例上提高了鉴别诊断召回率，但在急诊工作标签匹配上表现不佳：一项双队列、双模型家族评估
papers.author: Feng, J.
papers.summary: Background. Whether multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines help, add nothing, or underperform a single call may depend on the input and scoring contract rather than the architecture; these boundary conditions are unmapped. Methods. We compared a single direct call (Ax1), five personas in one context (P), and five isolated roles integrated by a moderator (MDT) across curated corpora (87 clinicopathological cases, 406 MedCaseReasoning cases, 392 replication vignettes) and two disjoint emergency cohorts from one repository (364 mixed-label encounters; a protocol-frozen 400-encounter disease-label-only replacement, one local serving stack). Scoring was judge-mediated top-k working-label matching. A completed factorial isolated the active ingredient; a symptom-permissive output-contract arm tested contract fit; three physicians rated discordant cases. Findings. On curated corpora MDT improved differential-list recall (top-3: +5.5 points, p = 0.0079; +3.0, p = 0.0079; +3.3, p = 0.0013) but not top-1 accuracy; the factorial attributed the gain to independent generation plus moderated synthesis, not personas. On emergency presentations the sign reversed: in the disease-label-only cohort Ax1 led MDT at every endpoint (top-3 -5.2 points, 95% CI -8.0 to -2.4, p = 0.0008), a second family reproduced it, and bridged cases excluded the serving stack. A symptom-permissive contract shrank the deficit's point estimates by 52-75%, replacement-cohort intervals all spanning zero though remaining negative; the clause harmed no arm. Physician safety ratings were inconclusive (original-cohort gate missed; replacement-cohort rescue contrast unadjudicable, 95% CI -32.7 to +2.6). Interpretation. Multi-agent diagnostic gains are real but conditional: the sign of the effect tracks input genre, and its magnitude tracks output-contract fit. Curated-benchmark gains should not be extrapolated to first-contact emergency text, where role-based teams underperform a single call at seven-fold token cost. The reversal is label-level and judge-mediated; clinical safety is neither established nor excluded.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。多智能体大语言模型（LLM）流水线究竟是有帮助、毫无增益，还是不如单次调用，可能取决于输入与评分契约而非架构；这些边界条件尚未被刻画。方法。我们在精选语料库（87 例临床病理病例、406 例 MedCaseReasoning 病例、392 个复现短病例）以及来自同一数据仓库的两个不相交急诊队列（364 例混合标签就诊；一个协议冻结的 400 例仅疾病标签替代队列，单一本地服务栈）上，比较了单次直接调用（Ax1）、单一上下文中的五个角色（P），以及由主持人整合的五个隔离角色（MDT）。评分采用裁判介导的 top-k 工作标签匹配。一项已完成的析因实验分离出有效成分；一个症状宽松的输出契约分支检验了契约契合度；三名医生对不一致病例进行了评分。发现。在精选语料库上，MDT 改善了鉴别诊断列表召回率（top-3：+5.5 个百分点，p = 0.0079；+3.0，p = 0.0079；+3.3，p = 0.0013），但未改善 top-1 准确率；析因实验将增益归因于独立生成加主持人整合，而非角色设定。在急诊就诊表现上，符号反转：在仅疾病标签队列中，Ax1 在每个终点均领先 MDT（top-3 -5.2 个百分点，95% CI -8.0 至 -2.4，p = 0.0008），第二个模型家族复现了该结果，桥接病例排除了服务栈的影响。症状宽松契约使缺陷的点估计缩小了 52-75%，替代队列的区间均跨越零但仍为负；该条款未损害任何分支。医生安全评分无定论（原始队列门槛未通过；替代队列救援对比无法裁定，95% CI -32.7 至 +2.6）。解释。多智能体诊断增益真实存在但有条件：效应符号随输入体裁而变化，其幅度随输出契约契合度而变化。精选基准上的增益不应外推到首诊急诊文本，在此类场景中基于角色的团队以七倍 token 成本却不如单次调用。该反转是标签层面且由裁判介导的；临床安全性既未确立也未排除。

papers.title: Beyond Perinatal Mood: Breadth of Psychiatric Symptoms and Delay Discounting as Correlates of Mothers' Relational Reports from Pregnancy Through Adult Children
papers.translated_title: 超越围产期情绪：精神症状的广度与延迟折扣作为母亲从孕期到成年子女关系报告的相关因素
papers.author: DeLauder, R.
papers.summary: Maternal mental illness affects roughly one in five mothers in the United States, yet most evidence linking it to the mother-child relationship comes from the first postpartum year and relies on self-report measures of depression, anxiety, and stress. In 613 women spanning five family contexts - pregnancy and mothers whose youngest child was aged 0-2, 3-12, 13-17, or 18 and older - we examined twelve psychological constructs as correlates of mothers' relational reports. Eleven were associated with relational reports individually; entered together, only three retained independent associations surviving false discovery rate correction: cross-domain psychiatric symptom burden (beta = 0.38), delay discounting (beta = -0.11), and orienting sensitivity (beta = 0.10). To our knowledge, this is the first peer-reviewed study linking delay discounting to maternal relational reports. Depression, anxiety, anger, perceived stress, and negative affect fell to non-significance, and the symptom composite that displaced them contains none of those domains, indicating that breadth of psychiatric symptoms, not their type, tracked relational reports. A person-centered analysis converged: the latent profile with the poorest relational reports was defined by symptoms across multiple domains rather than by elevated stress alone. Associations varied across family contexts, though because each context used a different relational instrument, differences cannot be attributed to child age. These cross-sectional findings suggest that the psychological dimension most closely tied to maternal relational reports is broader than the perinatal mood constructs around which research and screening are organized, and that cross-domain symptom assessment warrants prospective evaluation as a complement to mood screening.
papers.translated_summary: 在美国，约五分之一的母亲受到孕产妇精神疾病的影响，然而大多数将其与母子关系联系起来的证据来自产后第一年，并且依赖于对抑郁、焦虑和压力的自我报告测量。在涵盖五种家庭情境的613名女性中——包括孕期以及最小子女年龄为0-2岁、3-12岁、13-17岁或18岁及以上的母亲——我们考察了十二种心理构念与母亲关系报告的相关性。其中十一种构念单独与关系报告相关；同时纳入分析后，仅三种构念在经错误发现率校正后仍保留独立关联：跨领域精神症状负担（beta = 0.38）、延迟折扣（beta = -0.11）和定向敏感性（beta = 0.10）。据我们所知，这是首个将延迟折扣与母亲关系报告联系起来的同行评审研究。抑郁、焦虑、愤怒、感知压力和负性情绪均降至不显著，而取代它们症状复合变量不包含上述任何领域，表明与关系报告相关的是精神症状的广度而非其类型。以人为中心的分析结果一致：关系报告最差的潜在剖面由跨多个领域的症状所定义，而非仅由压力升高所定义。关联在不同家庭情境中存在差异，但由于每种情境使用了不同的关系测量工具，差异不能归因于子女年龄。这些横断面研究结果表明，与母亲关系报告联系最紧密的心理维度比研究和筛查所围绕的围产期情绪构念更为广泛，跨领域症状评估值得作为情绪筛查的补充进行前瞻性评估。

papers.title: Individualised and Time-Dependent Prediction of Recurrence After Colorectal Cancer Liver Metastases Resection
papers.translated_title: 结直肠癌肝转移切除术后复发的个体化及时间依赖性预测
papers.author: Viljamaa, A.
papers.summary: Introduction: Treatment strategies for colorectal cancer liver metastases (CRLM) are increasingly complex, driving interest in advanced prognostic tools. Externally validated benchmarks based on established clinical risk scores are needed to contextualise emerging models. However, existing scores remain difficult to apply and compare, because they provide categorical risk strata rather than individualised probabilities, and because model parameters are rarely published. Here, we validate and recalibrate seven established risk scores to derive individualised recurrence probabilities for future score benchmarking. Method: Patients undergoing index CRLM resection from two tertiary centres were included: Karolinska University Hospital (retrospective KaroLiver cohort [2013-2021, follow-up to 2025, n=709]) and Oslo University Hospital (OSLO-COMET trial cohort [2012-2016, follow-up to 2022, n=198]). Performance of the GAME, m-CS, Fong, Nordlinger, Nagashima, Konopke and Helsinki scores was assessed using recurrence-free survival as the primary outcome. Results: Among 709 patients in KaroLiver (median age 67 years [IQR 59-74]; 434 men [61%]), 422 (60%) had synchronous metastases and 444 (63%) received neoadjuvant chemotherapy. All scores significantly stratified recurrence risk (log-rank P<0.001; time-dependent AUC 0.63-0.74 at 3 years), albeit with performance differences across time points. Recalibrated models showed good agreement between predicted and observed recurrence and were externally validated in OSLO-COMET with broadly comparable net benefit. Models were implemented in the online tool PLATO (Personalised Liver metastases risk AssessmenT in Oncology). Conclusion: Established CRLM risk scores can be translated into individualised probabilistic recurrence estimates at clinically relevant time points, supporting patient communication, risk-adapted surveillance and transparent benchmarking of next-generation prognostic models.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：结直肠癌肝转移（CRLM）的治疗策略日益复杂，推动了人们对先进预后工具的关注。需要基于既有临床风险评分的外部验证基准，为新兴模型提供参照背景。然而，现有评分仍难以应用和比较，因为它们提供的是分类风险分层而非个体化概率，且模型参数很少公开发表。在此，我们验证并重新校准了七种既有风险评分，以推导个体化复发概率，供未来评分基准测试使用。方法：纳入来自两个三级中心的初次CRLM切除患者：卡罗林斯卡大学医院（回顾性KaroLiver队列[2013-2021年，随访至2025年，n=709]）和奥斯陆大学医院（OSLO-COMET试验队列[2012-2016年，随访至2022年，n=198]）。以无复发生存作为主要结局，评估GAME、m-CS、Fong、Nordlinger、Nagashima、Konopke和Helsinki评分的性能。结果：在KaroLiver的709例患者中（中位年龄67岁[IQR 59-74]；男性434例[61%]），422例（60%）伴有同时性转移，444例（63%）接受了新辅助化疗。所有评分均能显著分层复发风险（log-rank P<0.001；3年时时间依赖AUC 0.63-0.74），尽管不同时间点的性能存在差异。重新校准的模型显示预测复发与观察复发之间具有良好一致性，并在OSLO-COMET中进行了外部验证，净获益大体相当。模型已实现在在线工具PLATO（Personalised Liver metastases risk AssessmenT in Oncology）中。结论：既有CRLM风险评分可转化为临床相关时间点的个体化概率性复发估计，支持患者沟通、风险适应性监测以及下一代预后模型的透明基准测试。

papers.title: PlanetDiet: Sustainable diets and cardiometabolic health, study protocol for a six-month parallel-group randomized controlled trial in middle-aged adults at cardiovascular risk
papers.translated_title: PlanetDiet：可持续饮食与心脏代谢健康，一项为期六个月、在心血管风险中年成人中开展的平行组随机对照试验研究方案
papers.author: Trius-Soler, M.
papers.summary: Background: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) remains the leading cause of death worldwide. Diet plays a key role in CVD prevention while linking human health with environmental sustainability. The EAT-Lancet Commission proposed the Planetary Health Diet (PHD), a predominantly plant-based dietary pattern emphasizing high-quality foods and reduced meat consumption. Despite growing interest in the PHD, no randomized controlled trial (RCT) has evaluated its effects using the PHD index on established and novel cardiometabolic biomarkers. Methods: The PlanetDiet study is a six-month, three-arm parallel RCT investigating the effects of sustainable diets on traditional and novel cardiometabolic risk factors in 180 Danish adults aged 45?70 years at high cardiovascular risk. Participants are randomized to a PHD, an ovo-lacto-vegetarian diet, or their habitual diet (control). The primary outcome is changes in a composite cardiometabolic health score, with secondary outcomes including changes in metabolomic and proteomic profiles. Clinical assessments include the analysis of urine, blood, and faecal samples; continuous glucose monitoring; anthropometry and body composition measurements; dietary records; and self-reported questionnaires assessing physical activity, quality of life and dietary acceptance. To support adherence, participants receive four individualized dietary counselling sessions, two group sessions, seasonal food boxes tailored to their assigned diet, and access to a personalized digital application with recipes, individualized timelines, and visit scheduling. Conclusions: PlanetDiet will provide evidence on the effects of sustainable dietary patterns on cardiometabolic health. It will also investigate molecular pathways linking diet to cardiometabolic disease. Ultimately, the study may inform the development of effective, personalized dietary interventions that promote both human and planetary health. Trial registration: Sustainable Diets and Cardiometabolic Health (PlanetDiet): NCT07189676 [ClinicalTrials.gov] [registered before inclusion start; 2025-09-15]; Unique identifier: H-25030722.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：心血管疾病（CVD）仍是全球主要死因。饮食在CVD预防中发挥关键作用，同时将人类健康与环境可持续性联系起来。EAT-Lancet委员会提出了行星健康饮食（PHD），这是一种以植物性食物为主的饮食模式，强调高质量食物并减少肉类消费。尽管对PHD的兴趣日益增长，但尚无随机对照试验（RCT）使用PHD指数评估其对已确立的和新型心脏代谢生物标志物的影响。方法：PlanetDiet研究是一项为期六个月、三臂平行RCT，旨在研究可持续饮食对180名年龄45?70岁、心血管高风险丹麦成年人的传统和新型心脏代谢危险因素的影响。参与者被随机分配至PHD、蛋奶素食或习惯饮食（对照）组。主要结局是复合心脏代谢健康评分的变化，次要结局包括代谢组学和蛋白质组学谱的变化。临床评估包括尿液、血液和粪便样本分析；连续血糖监测；人体测量学和身体成分测量；饮食记录；以及评估身体活动、生活质量和饮食接受度的自报问卷。为提高依从性，参与者接受四次个体化饮食咨询、两次小组咨询、根据其分配饮食定制的季节性食物盒，以及一个包含食谱、个体化时间线和访视预约的个性化数字应用程序。结论：PlanetDiet将提供关于可持续饮食模式对心脏代谢健康影响的证据。该研究还将探讨连接饮食与心脏代谢疾病的分子通路。最终，该研究可能为制定促进人类和地球健康的有效、个性化饮食干预措施提供信息。试验注册：可持续饮食与心脏代谢健康（PlanetDiet）：NCT07189676 [ClinicalTrials.gov] [纳入开始前注册；2025-09-15]；唯一标识符：H-25030722。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Wearable and Biological Data Integration Reveals Physiological Signatures of Weight Variation in Overweight and Obese Adults: An AI4Food Machine Learning Study
papers.translated_title: 多模态可穿戴与生物数据整合揭示超重和肥胖成人群体重变化生理特征：一项AI4Food机器学习研究
papers.author: Attioui, H.
papers.summary: This study is part of the AI4Food project, which aims to identify the physiological and behavioral factors influencing weight variation in overweight and obese individuals through integrative analysis of multi-source data. A 30-day crossover intervention was conducted on 93 participants at IMDEA Nutrition Institute, combining a traditional phase (questionnaires, food diaries) and a digital phase (Fitbit Sense Smartwatch, FreeStyle Libre 2 glucose sensor). The collected data encompassed sleep, glucose, skin temperature, nutrition, and gut microbiome information. After rigorous preprocessing and alignment by intervention days, unsupervised clustering, association analysis, and machine learning models were applied to uncover physiological patterns linked to weight dynamics. Results showed greater weight reduction during the digital phase in Group 2, while between-group differences were not significant. Significant associations were observed between nocturnal respiratory rate, skin temperature, and weight variation. Under participant-level five-fold cross-validation, Random Forest models achieved mean accuracies of 64.3% for thermoregulation and 61.7% for glucose phenotype prediction, with RMSSD, restlessness, and nocturnal respiratory rate among the most influential predictors. In contrast, microbiome composition remained almost stable over the short intervention period. These findings support the potential of AI-driven integration of wearable and nutritional data to stratify metabolic phenotypes and advance personalized nutrition strategies in obesity management.
papers.translated_summary: 本研究是AI4Food项目的一部分，该项目旨在通过多源数据的整合分析，识别影响超重和肥胖个体体重变化的生理和行为因素。研究在IMDEA营养研究所对93名参与者开展了为期30天的交叉干预，结合了传统阶段（问卷、食物日记）和数字阶段（Fitbit Sense智能手表、FreeStyle Libre 2葡萄糖传感器）。所收集的数据涵盖睡眠、葡萄糖、皮肤温度、营养和肠道微生物组信息。经过严格预处理并按干预天数对齐后，应用无监督聚类、关联分析和机器学习模型，以揭示与体重动态相关的生理模式。结果显示，第2组在数字阶段体重下降幅度更大，但组间差异不显著。夜间呼吸频率、皮肤温度与体重变化之间观察到显著关联。在参与者级别的五折交叉验证下，随机森林模型在体温调节方面的平均准确率达到64.3%，在葡萄糖表型预测方面达到61.7%，其中RMSSD、不安度和夜间呼吸频率是最具影响力的预测因子。相比之下，微生物组组成在短期干预期间几乎保持稳定。这些发现支持了AI驱动的可穿戴设备与营养数据整合在代谢表型分层以及推进肥胖管理个性化营养策略方面的潜力。

papers.title: KNOWLEDGE, ATTITUDES AND PRACTICES OF REFUSE DISPOSAL IN OKELELE, ILORIN, NIGERIA
papers.translated_title: 尼日利亚伊洛林奥凯莱莱的垃圾处理知识、态度与实践
papers.author: IBRAHIM, M.
papers.summary: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Improper refuse disposal remains an environmental health concern in many Nigerian communities. This study assessed knowledge, attitudes and practices relating to refuse disposal among adult residents of Okelele community, Ilorin East Local Government Area, Kwara State, Nigeria. METHODS: A descriptive cross-sectional community-based study was conducted among 180 adults. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire covering sociodemographic characteristics, knowledge, attitudes and disposal practices. Descriptive statistics summarised responses, and chi-square tests assessed associations between categorical variables at a 5% significance level. RESULTS: Of 180 respondents, 102 (56.7%) had good knowledge, while 87 (48.3%) had negative attitudes and 99 (55.0%) had poor refuse-disposal practices. Commonly reported practices included incineration (50.6%), disposal into drains (30.6%) and open burning (21.7%). Absence of waste containers (37.2%) and distance to available containers (28.9%) were the leading reported barriers. Knowledge was associated with practice (chi-square=22.122; p<0.001) and attitude (chi-square=8.221; p=0.016); practice was also associated with attitude (chi-square=5.970; p=0.015). CONCLUSION AND IMPLICATIONS FOR TRANSLATION: Despite generally good knowledge, poor disposal practices were common. Improving access to reliable waste-collection infrastructure, alongside community education and enforcement of local waste-management measures, may help translate knowledge into safer practices. Keywords: Solid waste; Waste management; Knowledge; Attitude; Health behavior; Nigeria
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目标：不当的垃圾处理仍然是尼日利亚许多社区的环境健康问题。本研究评估了尼日利亚夸拉州伊洛林东地方政府区奥凯莱莱社区成年居民对垃圾处理的知识、态度和实践。方法：在180名成年人中开展了一项描述性横断面社区研究。数据通过结构化问卷收集，涵盖社会人口学特征、知识、态度和处理实践。描述性统计对回答进行汇总，卡方检验在5%显著性水平下评估分类变量之间的关联。结果：在180名受访者中，102人（56.7%）具有良好知识，而87人（48.3%）持消极态度，99人（55.0%）的垃圾处理实践较差。常见报告的做法包括焚烧（50.6%）、排入下水道（30.6%）和露天燃烧（21.7%）。缺乏垃圾容器（37.2%）和到可用容器的距离（28.9%）是报告的主要障碍。知识与实践相关（卡方=22.122；p<0.001）且与态度相关（卡方=8.221；p=0.016）；实践也与态度相关（卡方=5.970；p=0.015）。结论及对转化的启示：尽管知识总体良好，但不良处理实践十分普遍。改善获得可靠垃圾收集基础设施的机会，同时开展社区教育并执行地方废物管理措施，可能有助于将知识转化为更安全的实践。关键词：固体废物；废物管理；知识；态度；健康行为；尼日利亚

papers.title: Time at the curb, not the rate of head scanning, distinguishes street crossing in virtual reality with severe-to-profound visual impairment
papers.translated_title: 在严重至深度视觉障碍的情况下，虚拟现实中的过街表现取决于路缘停留时间，而非头部扫视速率。
papers.author: Erkat-Cohen, B.
papers.summary: Purpose: We tested whether people with severe-to-profound visual impairment compensate at street crossings with more head scanning and/or more time at the curb. Methods: Ten normally sighted controls, tested with normal vision and with Bangerter filters simulating severe-to-profound visual impairment (approximately 20/2000), and 17 adults with severe-to-profound visual impairment crossed a virtual street in a head-mounted display. Four complexity levels ranged from an empty street to yielding vehicles with pedestrian avatars; only the two most complex levels contained moving vehicles. Cumulative absolute head yaw and latency to step-off were analyzed with mixed-effects models, and latencies were fitted with an ex-Gaussian distribution. Results: Compared with normal vision, latency to step-off was 1.57 times longer with simulated and 1.82 times longer with clinical severe-to-profound visual impairment (Bonferroni p < 0.001 and p = 0.008, respectively). In severe-to-profound visual impairment, the additional latency was attributable to the slow tail of the latency distribution (exponential component {tau} longer by 3.40 s without and 6.20 s with moving vehicles; Bonferroni p = 0.037 and 0.022, respectively); peak position did not differ significantly. Before step-off, cumulative absolute head yaw increased with complexity, F(3, 115.8) = 37.16, p < 0.001, and was 1.88 times higher with simulated impairment than with normal vision (Bonferroni p = 0.024); it did not differ significantly between clinical impairment and normal vision, either before step-off or during walking (both Bonferroni p [≥] 0.479). During walking, its increase with complexity depended on viewing condition, F(6, 109.3) = 5.23, p < 0.001. Conclusions: Severe-to-profound visual impairment was associated with longer and more variable time at the curb, without a significant increase in cumulative head scanning, although the increase in head scanning with complexity during walking was attenuated. Time at the curb is relevant to orientation and mobility practice and accessible crossing design.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：我们测试了严重至深度视觉障碍者是否在过街时通过更多的头部扫视和/或在路缘停留更长时间来进行补偿。方法：十名视力正常的对照者，在正常视力下以及使用Bangerter滤光片模拟严重至深度视觉障碍（约20/2000）的条件下接受测试；另有17名患有严重至深度视觉障碍的成年人在头戴式显示器中穿越虚拟街道。四种复杂度水平从空街道到有行人化身的让行车辆不等；只有两个最复杂的水平包含移动车辆。使用混合效应模型分析累积绝对头部偏航角和起步潜伏期，并对潜伏期拟合指数-高斯分布。结果：与正常视力相比，模拟严重至深度视觉障碍下起步潜伏期延长1.57倍，临床严重至深度视觉障碍下延长1.82倍（Bonferroni p < 0.001和p = 0.008）。在严重至深度视觉障碍中，额外的潜伏期可归因于潜伏期分布的慢尾（指数成分{tau}在无移动车辆时延长3.40秒，有移动车辆时延长6.20秒；Bonferroni p = 0.037和0.022）；峰值位置无显著差异。起步前，累积绝对头部偏航角随复杂度增加而增大，F(3, 115.8) = 37.16，p < 0.001，且模拟障碍下比正常视力高1.88倍（Bonferroni p = 0.024）；临床障碍与正常视力之间在起步前或行走期间均无显著差异（Bonferroni p [≥] 0.479）。行走期间，其随复杂度的增加取决于观看条件，F(6, 109.3) = 5.23，p < 0.001。结论：严重至深度视觉障碍与更长且更多变的路缘停留时间相关，而累积头部扫视无显著增加，尽管行走期间头部扫视随复杂度的增加有所减弱。路缘停留时间与定向和移动实践及无障碍过街设计相关。

papers.title: Co-Design of the VIRtual physiotherapist-led Triage of referrals to shoUlder surgEons (VIRTUE) model of care: a study protocol
papers.translated_title: 虚拟物理治疗师主导的肩部外科医生转诊分诊（VIRTUE）照护模式的协同设计：一项研究方案
papers.author: Gamble, A. R.
papers.summary: Background: Rotator cuff-related shoulder pain accounts for up to 85% of shoulder pain. Guidelines recommend 6 months of non-surgical care before considering surgery, yet many are referred to a surgeon before trying it. High referral rates to public hospital shoulder surgery clinics in Australia mean many patients wait 1-2 years to see a surgeon, during which symptoms may become more complex and costly to manage. A promising solution is the VIRtual physiotherapist-led Triage of referrals to shoUlder surgEons (VIRTUE) model of care, in which physiotherapists screen new referrals and determine suitability for non-surgical care or surgical review. However, no such model has been co-designed to incorporate virtual care nor evaluated in a randomised controlled trial. Aims: The broad aim of this study is to co-design the VIRTUE model of care ready for evaluation in a randomised controlled trial conducted in public hospital shoulder surgery clinics in Australia. Specifically, this study has two aims (two stages): i) explore stakeholders perceptions of the feasibility, acceptability and implementation of the VIRTUE model of care for adults with rotator cuff-related shoulder pain who are referred to public hospital shoulder surgery clinics; and ii) co-design the VIRTUE model of care so that it is user-centred and acceptable to patients, clinicians and key stakeholders. Methods: Stage 1 is a qualitative descriptive study using semi-structured online interviews with patients, clinicians and key stakeholders, recruited using purposive, maximum variation sampling. Interviews will explore experiences of current care, perceptions of the proposed model, and barriers and facilitators to implementation, guided by the Theoretical Framework for Acceptability and Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research. Stage 2 will use Experience-Based Co-Design methodology and involves three online workshops: separate workshops for patients, and for clinicians and key stakeholders, then a combined workshop. Workshops will explore Stage 1 findings, perceptions of the proposed model, and refinements needed to finalise it, with data mapped to the Framework for Reporting Adaptations and Modifications-Expanded. Conclusion: Co-designing VIRTUE with patients, clinicians and key stakeholders will ensure it is user-centred, acceptable and feasible within Australian public health services, ready for evaluation in a randomised controlled trial. By facilitating timely and equitable access to evidence-based care, VIRTUE could improve outcomes for patients, ensure specialist services are available for those most in need, and improve health system performance.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：肩袖相关肩痛占肩痛的比例高达85%。指南建议在考虑手术前先进行6个月的非手术治疗，但许多患者在尝试非手术治疗之前就被转诊至外科医生。澳大利亚公立医院肩部手术诊所的转诊率高，意味着许多患者需要等待1至2年才能见到外科医生，在此期间症状可能变得更加复杂，管理成本也更高。一种有前景的解决方案是VIRTUE（虚拟物理治疗师主导的肩部外科医生转诊分诊）照护模式，即由物理治疗师筛查新转诊患者，判断其适合非手术照护还是手术评估。然而，目前尚无此类模式经过共同设计以纳入虚拟照护，也未经随机对照试验评估。目的：本研究的总体目标是共同设计VIRTUE照护模式，使其能够在澳大利亚公立医院肩部手术诊所开展的随机对照试验中进行评估。具体而言，本研究有两个目标（两个阶段）：i）探讨利益相关者对VIRTUE照护模式的可接受性、可行性和实施情况的看法，该模式面向因肩袖相关肩痛被转诊至公立医院肩部手术诊所的成人患者；ii）共同设计VIRTUE照护模式，使其以用户为中心，并为患者、临床医生和关键利益相关者所接受。方法：第1阶段为定性描述性研究，采用半结构化在线访谈，访谈对象为患者、临床医生和关键利益相关者，通过目的性最大变异抽样招募。访谈将在可接受性理论框架和实施研究整合框架的指导下，探讨当前照护体验、对所提模式的看法以及实施的障碍和促进因素。第2阶段将采用基于经验的共同设计方法，包括三次在线工作坊：分别为患者和临床医生及关键利益相关者举办单独的工作坊，然后举办一次联合工作坊。工作坊将探讨第1阶段的发现、对所提模式的看法以及最终确定该模式所需的改进，数据将映射至适应与修改报告框架扩展版。结论：与患者、临床医生和关键利益相关者共同设计VIRTUE，将确保其以用户为中心、可接受且在澳大利亚公共卫生服务中可行，并准备好接受随机对照试验评估。通过促进及时、公平地获得循证照护，VIRTUE可以改善患者结局，确保最需要的人群能够获得专科服务，并提升卫生系统绩效。

papers.title: Sex, age and HIV-1 status influence complement activation against SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccine Spike protein
papers.translated_title: 性别、年龄和HIV-1状态影响针对SARS-CoV-2 mRNA疫苗Spike蛋白的补体激活
papers.author: Tuttle, D. J.
papers.summary: Regulation of complement activity influences immunity and clinical outcomes of SARS-2 CoV-2 infections. Here we investigated antibody responses to SARS-CoV-2 vaccination and complement activity in men (age 36 to 86) and women (age 39 to 83) with (MWH, WWH) and without (MWOH, WWOH) HIV-1. Antibody responses in WWH were lower than in MWH. WWH also had negligible change in blood C3a post-immunization, whereas MWH had greater C3a levels. We investigated the levels of C5, C5a, C1-INH, factor H, and circulating immune complex-C1q (CIC-C1q) binding to understand the regulation of complement activity. We found that C1-INH and anti-S antibody levels were driving the differences in C3 convertase activity in MWH. No significant differences were found between C5 and C5a in both cohorts, suggesting that C5 convertase is not being activated. These results show that biological sex may impact SARS-CoV-2 immune responses and highlights the need for further investigation.
papers.translated_summary: 补体活性的调控影响SARS-2 CoV-2感染的免疫和临床结局。本研究调查了伴（MWH、WWH）与不伴（MWOH、WWOH）HIV-1感染的男性（年龄36至86岁）和女性（年龄39至83岁）对SARS-CoV-2疫苗接种的抗体反应及补体活性。WWH的抗体反应低于MWH。WWH免疫后血液C3a变化可忽略不计，而MWH的C3a水平较高。我们检测了C5、C5a、C1-INH、因子H以及循环免疫复合物-C1q（CIC-C1q）结合水平，以了解补体活性的调控。我们发现C1-INH和抗S抗体水平驱动了MWH中C3转化酶活性的差异。两个队列中C5与C5a之间均未发现显著差异，提示C5转化酶未被激活。这些结果表明生物学性别可能影响SARS-CoV-2免疫反应，并凸显了进一步研究的必要性。

papers.title: Genotypic infection endpoint analysis to understand efficacy and escape potential of the malaria monoclonal antibody CIS43LS
papers.translated_title: 基因型感染终点分析以理解疟疾单克隆抗体CIS43LS的效力和逃逸潜力
papers.author: Schwabl, P.
papers.summary: Early-phase trials of candidate malaria interventions in endemic areas often use "time-to-first" infection as a primary efficacy endpoint. This approach does not assess infection risk after the initial infection, and its censoring of trial participants after their first infection can introduce bias by removing more high-risk participants from control than treatment arms over time. Efficacy estimate precision may also decline as risk set size decreases. Here we assessed the utility of genotyping all infections in an intervention trial to determine the total infection incidence in each participant for the full follow-up period. Specifically, we genotyped all Plasmodium falciparum infections detected in a previously-reported phase 2 trial of the antimalarial monoclonal antibody CIS43LS in 330 Malian adults. We determined the molecular force of infection (molFOI; rate of new P. falciparum strains) for each participant, expressing efficacy as the percent molFOI reduction in CIS43LS versus placebo arms (EffmolFOI). Six-month EffmolFOI was 86.5% (95% CI: 80.1-90.8) and 70.7% (61.0-78.0) for the 40 mg/kg and 10 mg/kg doses, respectively. These estimates are similar to those from time-to-first infection analysis, but more precise when analyzing efficacy by trial-month and when stratifying by P. falciparum infection-status at enrollment. Participants infected at enrollment had lower EffmolFOI and acquired infections earlier in the trial, creating systematic differences in risk composition between arms over time. Genotyping showed no evidence for escape-polymorphisms in the CIS43LS epitope. These results demonstrate how genotypic endpoints can provide a more comprehensive understanding of candidate malaria interventions.
papers.translated_summary: 在疟疾流行区开展的候选疟疾干预措施早期试验，常以“首次感染时间”作为主要疗效终点。该方法不评估初次感染后的感染风险，且在受试者首次感染后对其进行删失，会随着时间推移使对照组中高风险受试者被剔除的比例高于治疗组，从而引入偏倚。随着风险集规模缩小，疗效估计的精确度也可能下降。在此，我们评估了一项干预试验中对所有感染进行基因分型的效用，以确定每位受试者在整个随访期内的总感染发生率。具体而言，我们对一项先前报道的、在330名马里成年人中开展的抗疟单克隆抗体CIS43LS 2期试验中检测到的所有恶性疟原虫感染进行了基因分型。我们确定了每位受试者的分子感染力（molFOI；新恶性疟原虫株的出现率），并将疗效表示为CIS43LS组相对于安慰剂组的molFOI降低百分比（EffmolFOI）。40 mg/kg和10 mg/kg剂量组的六个月EffmolFOI分别为86.5%（95% CI：80.1-90.8）和70.7%（61.0-78.0）。这些估计值与首次感染时间分析的结果相似，但在按试验月份分析疗效以及按入组时恶性疟原虫感染状态分层时更为精确。入组时已感染的受试者EffmolFOI较低，且在试验中更早获得感染，导致各组间随时间推移的风险构成出现系统性差异。基因分型未显示CIS43LS表位存在逃逸多态性的证据。这些结果表明，基因型终点如何能够更全面地理解候选疟疾干预措施。
